title: One 2020 Storm Hit 140 mph Winds Across 700 Miles

scenes.text: In 2020, one storm hit with 140 mile per hour winds.
It was a derecho, a line of storms with straight-line winds.
It raced across a 700-mile stretch from Nebraska to Indiana.
More than 40 percent of Iowa's corn and soybeans were severely damaged.
Damage was estimated at seven and a half billion dollars. Just wind, for 700 miles.

description:
On August 10, 2020, a derecho swept 700 miles from Nebraska to Indiana with winds up to 140 miles per hour.
It damaged more than 40 percent of Iowa's corn and soybeans.
Have you ever been in a storm this strong?
first_comment: Had you ever heard the word derecho before this?
